title: L’UNESCO recrute un(e) Consultant(e) en charge de la mise à niveau de la plateforme StatEduc du SIGE, Yaoundé, Cameroun
why_not: Describes the census only: StatEduc (UIS), installed from April 2018 with GPE funds through PAEQUE/World Bank in MINEDUB, MINESEC, MINEFOP, MINESUP and MINJEC, manages school databases and produces the statistical yearbooks from collection tools and entry masks; the SIGE is this plus the carte scolaire, under the 2021-2030 SIGE plan and PAREC Pillar 6. No learner record, no entry by schools during the year. Class on this text: census. A vacancy reproduced on a job board; the page carries no date of its own and cites a September 2024 agreement.
